name: Wetten, dass..?
description: A long-running German-language entertainment television show based on the format of the British show You Bet! and the American show Wanna Bet?.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Bizarre betting ideas, big machines, clever kids and lots of stars on the famous couch: Thomas Gottschalk presents the TV highlight of the year with "Wetten, dass..." on Saturday, 6 November 2021, live from 8.15 p.m. on ORF 1, ZDF and SRF from the exhibition hall in Nuremberg. Big stars tremble along as the contestants compete for everything. Michelle Hunziker will of course be there, and of course a dredger bet is not to be missed. A special highlight is the visit of ABBA.
